messages:
Ankit: ran kv-cache paging sensitivity sweep across GPUs + regions. attached p95/p99 & hit-rate by seqlen buckets. major findings: A100 best p99 for long seqs, 4090 shows higher tail under paging, H100 + int8 reduces p95 ~18% when cache hit >70% but has ~1.2% quality delta. full logs + plots at s3://redwood-prod/bench/1776543210/results.tar.gz :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maggie: nice. what's the seqlen distribution? heavy tail or uniform?
Ankit: heavy-tail mix: 70% short (<64), 20% mid (64-512), 10% long (>1024). i'll push raw CSVs.
Zach: can you paste the exact command/flags used? want to reproduce with kernel=triton_fused_attn
Ankit: ```
./run_kv_bench --model redwood-small-v2 --seq-dist heavy_tail.json --cache-size 64MB --page-size 16kb --evict-policy lru --prefetch async --kernel default --quant int8 --runs 12 --out s3://redwood-prod/bench/1776543210/
```
Lee: noted region differences — us-west A100 hosts on gen4 interconnect, eu-west H100 nodes in that region are on slightly older fabric; might explain higher p99 in eu-west for long sequences.
Maggie: what eviction policy + prefetch params were used for 4090 vs A100?
Ankit: LRU + page_size=16kb + async prefetch=on for A100. for 4090 we disabled async prefetch (stability flakiness), so those runs are sync-only.
Zach: try evict=clock_pro + prefetch_window=8 in next sweep — we've seen lower p99 for mixed seqlen workloads.
Ankit: will do. also ran quantization comparison: int8 static vs int4 per-channel. int4 shaved ~3% latency overall but introduced ~2.6% quality delta on the eval prompts (we measure KL & token-level mimic).
Maggie: can you translate hit-rate -> token-cost savings roughly?
Ankit: quick numbers from the sweep: 80% hit -> ~30% token-cost drop; 70% -> ~22%; 60% -> ~12%. i'll produce a cost curve per-model+region.
ci-bot: Benchmark job 1776543210 completed: 12 runs. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/bench/1776543210/ (csv + png + summary.json). CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1776543210 :white_check_mark:
Lee: kernel choice matters: triton_fused_attn wins for seq >512 (better fused kernels & lower memory copies). cuBLAS path is still better for <128 because of lower kernel-launch overhead.
Zach: agree. also double-check PCIe vs NVLink bandwidth for cross-GPU cache migrations — affects paging penalty a lot.
Ankit: note: prefetch_window=8 was used for A100 baseline. 4090 baseline used window=0. will include a matrix sweep next run (window 0/4/8/16).
Maggie: can you add the main plots (hit-rate vs p95/p99, cost curves) to the model-onboarding PR and flag any regressions?
Ankit: yes. next steps: run clock_pro evict + triton_fused kernel combo in eu-west + us-east on H100/4090 to confirm tail behavior. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Maggie: :thumbsup: thanks — please pin the summary PNGs to the PR and add a short note about the quant tradeoffs.
